summary: Per-residue binary prediction of which residues form ligand/cofactor binding sites.
what_it_measures: For each residue, a 0/1 label for whether it is an annotated binding-site residue. Labels come from Swiss-Prot 'Binding site' sequence features (positions expanded to a per-residue binary vector).
assay_method: Expert-curated binding-site annotations in Swiss-Prot (substrate/cofactor/metal contacts), from experimental and homology evidence.
provenance: Parsed from the Swiss-Prot `binding_positions` feature column into residue-position vectors; the full per-residue embedding tensor is retained by the model.
when_to_use: A residue-level localization task probing whether embeddings identify binding pockets; useful for functional-site annotation and engineering.
caveats: Imbalanced: 2.51% of the residues in the dataset are annotated. AUPRC is the primary metric. Distinct from BioLiP binding, which classifies protein and ligand pairs rather than residues. Annotation coverage is incomplete.
